'''Nightroad''', or the '''Nigut Road''', was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and [[Terr'skiar]] in [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor sector]] and [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar sector]]. It was plagued by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]].<ref name="TEA" />
